title: ALKIS Flurstücke — the legal parcel spine
role: PARCEL SPINE — must exist before the B-Plan join, because the buildability answer attaches to the Flurstück (point-in-polygon of the parcel against the applicable plan).
endpointConfidence: CONVERGENT-SECONDARY — base GDI-BE WFS host; exact ALKIS Flurstück feature-type name to be locked via GetCapabilities (see also gis/alkis-source.json which records the /alkis_flurstuecke form; reconcile which is production).
parcelIdFieldConfidence: PROBE-REQUIRED — AAA/ALKIS id; verify exact field name via DescribeFeatureType

quality.ownershipNote: ⚠ NOT a substitute for the ownership register (Grundbuch). ALKIS is the cadastral geometry/id spine only; it does not certify ownership.

joins.parcelToPlan: point-in-polygon (parcel geometry vs B-Plan SpatialPlan polygon) -> applicable planid
joins.parcelToBuilding: LoD2 CityGML / ALKIS Gebäude (existing built form; see gis/lod2-source.json)

probeRequired: Exact ALKIS Flurstück feature-type name + geometry field (GetCapabilities / DescribeFeatureType).
Confirm parcelIdField `flurstueckskennzeichen` and the four administrative key fields.
Confirm CRS EPSG:25833 and the applicable licence.
